rules.title: General Laws Part I, Title VII, Chapter 40P, Section 4 (General prohibition; exception)
rules.requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A municipality that accepts the chapter may adopt only voluntary rent control that excludes regulation of occupancy, services, evictions and condominium conversion, excludes owners of fewer than ten units and units with fair market rent over $400, and requires the municipality to compensate owners from general funds.
rules.key_value: Rent control barred; narrow exception: voluntary after six months, owners of fewer than ten units and units over $400 fair market rent excluded, municipality compensates owners
rules.citation: General Laws Part I, Title VII, Chapter 40P, Section 4
rules.status_basis: Appears in the Massachusetts General Laws code; enactment date not stated in the chunk.

coverage.summary: Applies to all cities and towns and to rental housing generally.
